from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u007/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the full-width or full-height divider.
    split = None
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and 0 < r < h - 1:
            split = ("h", r)
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(w):
            col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
            if len(set(col)) == 1 and 0 < c < w - 1:
                split = ("v", c)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("no divider found")
    axis, k = split
    if axis == "h":
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
        common = set(map(set, a))  # overwritten below with all-cell color sets
        ca = {x for row in a for x in row}
        cb = {x for row in b for x in row}
        base = next(iter(ca & cb))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else base for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(a))]
    a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
    b = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    ca = {x for row in a for x in row}
    cb = {x for row in b for x in row}
    base = next(iter(ca & cb))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else base for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(h)]
'''
# Remove unnecessary line and make the split detection favor the separator across either dimension.
code=code.replace('        common = set(map(set, a))  # overwritten below with all-cell color sets\n','')
p=programs/'task-cdd097ff.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
